movie.title: Spa Weekend
movie.overview: Four lifelong friends realize that somewhere between careers, relationships, families and everyday responsibilities, they have forgotten how to take care of themselves and each other. Burned out and overdue for a break, the women escape to a luxury spa retreat for what turns out to be an unforgettable weekend dedicated to fun, laughter, and a lot of really bad decisions.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: Burned out by adult responsibilities, four lifelong friends escape to a luxury spa retreat for a hilarious weekend of reconnection, laughter, and unpredictable misadventures.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Overwhelmed by the crushing weight of careers, relationships, and family life, four lifelong friends realize they have neglected themselves and their bond. To reclaim their sanity, they book a getaway at an exclusive luxury spa retreat, hoping for relaxation and pampering. However, their peaceful weekend quickly devolves into a series of wild antics, unexpected drama, and wonderfully terrible decisions. Ultimately, the chaotic retreat forces them to rediscover the joy, healing, and strength found in true sisterhood.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Smothered by the daily grind of careers, family obligations, and personal pressures, four lifelong friends hit a collective breaking point and realize how disconnected they have grown. Desperate for a reset, they decide to leave their responsibilities behind for a weekend getaway at an opulent luxury spa retreat. What is supposed to be a tranquil escape filled with cucumber water and massages quickly turns upside down as old habits and unresolved tensions resurface. Driven by a newfound desire to let loose, the group embarks on a wild spree of poor choices, chaotic misadventures, and late-night antics that throw the serene resort into utter disarray. Along the way, secrets are revealed, long-standing grievances come to light, and their deep bond is tested under the weight of personal truths. Despite the escalating mayhem, each woman is forced to confront the harsh realities of burnout and the self-care they have severely neglected. Laughter alternates with raw, honest heart-to-hearts as they help each other navigate their personal crossroads. By the time the tumultuous weekend comes to a close, the four friends leave the retreat far less rested than planned, but deeply recharged in spirit. Together, they emerge from the chaotic getaway with a renewed commitment to their friendship and a healthier outlook on balancing life's endless demands.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Spa Weekend follows four lifelong friends who find themselves completely overwhelmed by the unrelenting pressures of adulthood, careers, and family life. Realizing they have sacrificed their well-being and their connection with one another, they decide to escape to a high-end luxury spa retreat for a much-needed break. Expecting a peaceful sanctuary of meditation and pampering, the women instead ignite a spark of long-suppressed rebellion. What unfolds is an unforgettable, comedy-filled journey packed with bad decisions, heartfelt revelations, and uninhibited fun that serves as a hilarious love letter to female friendship and self-discovery.

story_structure.climax: A major bad decision triggers a chaotic breaking point where long-simmering secrets and frustrations finally boil over in dramatic fashion.
story_structure.conflict: The women struggle to disconnect from their underlying stresses and realize they have drifted apart, leading their attempts at self-care to spiral into chaos.
story_structure.resolution: Through open honesty and shared laughter over the disaster, the friends repair their bonds, rediscover themselves, and return home with renewed clarity and strength.
story_structure.introduction: Four burned-out lifelong friends leave behind their busy lives and personal responsibilities to head out on a luxury spa retreat.
story_structure.risingAction: As the weekend progresses, a series of increasingly reckless decisions, humorous mishaps, and mounting tensions test the limits of their friendship and the spa's rules.

characters.name: Jane
characters.description: Played by Leslie Mann, Jane is an overworked mom and career woman seeking to re-center her life and reconnect with her lifelong friends during the getaway.

characters.name: Mel
characters.description: Played by Isla Fisher, Mel is the uninhibited wild card whose unexpected arrival and impulsive nature drive the group into hilarious bad decisions.

characters.name: Coco
characters.description: Played by Michelle Buteau, Coco brings quick wit, blunt humor, and energetic banter to the group's chaotic retreat.

characters.name: Sophie
characters.description: Played by Anna Faris, Sophie is an exhausted friend looking for peaceful relaxation who repeatedly gets swept up in the weekend's escalating madness.

characters.name: Charming Spa Guest
characters.description: Played by Adam Demos, a handsome encounter at the luxury resort who adds romantic temptation and comedy to the women's trip.
